B027-01.notes: Downstream 12 km/h, upstream 8 km/h; current = (12-8)/2 = 2. Trap: 4 (difference not halved), 10 (still-water speed).

B027-02.notes: Zeros x=3, x=2, x=-2 -> 3 distinct values. Trap: 2 (forgetting -2).

B027-03.notes: 5x-10 = 3x+30 -> x=20; exterior = 90. Choice A = x trap.

B027-05.notes: Prime sums 2,3,5,7,11: 1+2+4+6+2 = 15 outcomes; 15/36 = 5/12. 5/11 trap counts sums 2-12 as equally likely.

B027-10.notes: Minute hand 300 deg, hour hand 60+25 = 85 deg; difference 215, smaller angle 145. Trap: 120 / 160-type answers that ignore hour-hand drift; 135 if hand drift miscomputed.
